decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Let me analyze this situation:

- My Garchomp (169 Spe) is facing opponent's Hydreigon (106-165 Spe range)
- Garchomp has Rough Skin ability, which damages contact moves
- Hydreigon is Dark/Dragon, so Dragon-type moves are super effective on it
- Earthquake is NOT effective because Hydreigon has Levitate (immune to Ground)
- Dragon Claw is super effective (2x) on Hydreigon
- Stone Edge is neutral on Hydreigon (Rock vs Dark/Dragon = neutral)

Key considerations:
- Earthquake is useless against Hydreigon due to Levitate
- Dragon Claw is the best attacking move here - super effective, 100% accuracy
- Swords Dance could work if I can set up safely, but Hydreigon can hit hard with Dracometeor (super effective on Garchomp) or Dark Pulse
- I should attack with Dragon Claw to deal damage immediately
- Rough Skin will trigger if Hydreigon uses contact moves, but Dracometeor and Dark Pulse are non-contact

The safest and most effective play is Dragon Claw for immediate super effective damage.

I'll bring Kingambit as it has broader coverage against the remaining potential threats and is very bulky.

- With 205 Atk vs Clefable's 83-137 Def, this should do significant damage

So Kingambit resists Moonblast. I could set up Swords Dance safely.

But wait - Clefable might have Unaware (ignores stat changes), which would make Swords Dance useless against it. Or Magic Guard (immune to indirect damage). Or Cute Charm.

If Clefable has Unaware, Swords Dance is useless. If it has Magic Guard, it still takes direct damage from Iron Head.

Given the uncertainty, I think Iron Head is the safest move. It's super effective, and even without Swords Dance, it should do good damage. If Clefable has Unaware, I can still break through with raw power.

Actually, let me reconsider. Kingambit with 205 Atk and Iron Head (80 BP, 2x SE) should do massive damage even without setup. Let me estimate:

= 4 × 80 × 205 / 110 × 2 × 1.1
= 4 × 80 × 1.864 × 2 × 1.1
= ~1313... that can't be right.

Let me use the proper formula:
Damage = ((((2 × Level / 5) + 2) × Power × A/D) / 50) + 2
= ((((2 × 50 / 5) + 2) × 80 × 205 / 110) / 50) + 2
= ((22 × 80 × 205 / 110) / 50) + 2
= ((22 × 149.09) / 50) + 2
= (3280 / 50) + 2
= 65.6 + 2 = 67.6

With SE (×2): 135.2
With Supreme Overlord (×1.1): 148.7

Clefable has 170-202 HP. So Iron Head does about 73-87% damage. That's very good!

If Clefable has max HP (202), Iron Head does about 73%. If min HP (170), about 87%.

I think Iron Head is the best choice here. It's super effective, does massive damage, and doesn't rely on setup that might be negated by Unaware.

Let me go with Iron Head.
